headlines.description: — With their top two quarterbacks injured, the Baltimore Ravens were prepared to use any trick necessary in their attempt to keep the game competitive against Jacksonville. That included snapping the ball directly to Derrick Henry on quite a few...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars thrash the depleted Ravens 33-10 for their 5th win in 6 games

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow threw for three touchdowns and rushed for another and the Cincinnati Bengals' offense kept rolling to defeat the Atlanta Falcons 34-17 in Madrid on Sunday for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow powers Bengals past the Falcons in Madrid for their 4th straight win

headlines.description: — With the Dallas Cowboys trailing by three points and on the verge of yet another fourth-quarter collapse, Dak Prescott needed 29 seconds to bail them out.
headlines.shortLinkText: Javonte Williams' late TD run helps Cowboys avoid another 4th-quarter collapse and beat Colts 27-23

headlines.description: — Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes walked off the field dangling his right arm, which had been bent grotesquely on a strip-sack by the Jets' David Bailey, and for the briefest of moments a pall seemed to descend over Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenneth Walker scores 3 TDs as the Chiefs roll past the woeful Jets 35-12 to end their 2-game skid

events.name: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions have repeated a mantra all week in the aftermath of a scary neck injury to All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions grind past Dolphins 19-9 as Jahmyr Gibbs scores and Jake Bates makes 4 field goals

headlines.description: — Saints second-year quarterback Tyler Shough likes to think he has a refined and thoughtful approach to remaining calm and in control in the clutch.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints hold on for a 23-22 overtime victory over the Browns by stopping a 2-point conversion

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy may as well have been any New York Giants fan nervously watching on TV as the injured quarterback tossed a football to keep warm and paced around the locker room.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, McCarthy combine to lead Giants to 19-11 win and hand Eagles 7th straight loss

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — There's still room for growth from the star-studded Rams, but they're starting to show again why they were a preseason Super Bowl favorite.
headlines.shortLinkText: Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett lead Rams to 20-13 win over Commanders

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos continue to know how to win close games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix throws for 2 TDs, Broncos win key challenge to beat Panthers 26-21 for fifth straight victory

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud had been feeling lousy all week, barely practiced and woke up with chills on game day. Then he had his version of Michael Jordan's flu game.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud tosses 5 TD passes as Texans rout winless Chargers 44-22. LA finally scores a TD

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — If Jordan Love has played a better game than he did on Sunday, he can't remember it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love accounts for 4 touchdowns, Packers force 4 turnovers in 45-27 win over Patriots

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Jaden Dugger set the tone for the second half when he returned an interception from Kirk Cousins on the first play for a touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers capitalize on 5 2nd-half takeaways to cruise past Raiders 38-17

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — AJ Barner's breakout came just when the Seahawks needed it.
headlines.shortLinkText: AJ Barner has a TD catch and runs for a score in Seahawks' 17-3 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears played one of their worst games of the season — and won.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williams connects with Loveland to set up Santos' winning field goal as Bears edge Buccaneers 27-24

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: - The Buffalo Bills knew they weren't bound for many style points or likely to reach their league-leading scoring average against Minnesota's relentlessly...
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen and the Bills move to 7-1 with a 23-6 win over the sputtering Vikings
